notes.decision: Translated 'wears the body' preserving the Greek loan φορεῖν 'wear/bear (as garment)' as in glossary entry ⲣⲫⲟⲣⲉ. The soul wears the body as a garment — standard Manichaean somatic register.
Translated 'unto her' per glossary entry ⲍⲓⲣⲉⲧ⸗ 'unto (the feet of)'; here with 3sg.f suffix, marking the soul as object of the Mind of Light's salvific arrival.

Both verbs are 3sg.m habitual + 3sg.f object: 'he establishes her, he purifies her.' The actor is the Mind of Light (line 2); the object is the soul. ⲥⲁⲧϩ̄ = ⲥⲱⲧⲡ̄/ⲥⲁⲑⲏⲧ 'set, fix' or possibly a Lyc establish-stem (cf. ⲉⲥⲥⲁⲧϩ̄ line 26 of food being 'established'). ⲧⲟⲩⲃⲁⲥ = ⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ-ⲥ̄ 'purify her.'

Tentatively rendered 'shock.' The lexeme stands in a triadic series with ⲱⲧⲁⲣⲧⲣ̄ 'disturbance' and ⲧⲁⲣⲁⲭⲏ 'tarachē', all denoting agitation. Possibly Lyc form related to ⲧⲱϩⲥ̄ 'strike, smite.' Confidence low.
ⲛⲉϩ- (Lyc 'his') + ⲍⲱⲁⲟⲛ (Greek ζῷα plural 'living-creatures'). In cosmological context here = his cosmic living-creatures = the zodiacal animal-figures, paired with 'his stars on high.'

Translated 'grief.' Recurring on this page (lines 9, 16, 22) in triadic series with ⲧⲃⲁⲕⲉ 'bitterness' and ⲧⲁⲩⲡⲏ (λύπη) 'lupē/sorrow.' Possibly Lyc form related to ⲡⲕⲏ/ⲡⲱϣ-ⲛϩⲏⲧ 'distress, division of heart.'
Parsed as ⲛ̄-ⲥ-(ⲛⲁ)-ⲣ̄-ⲁⲡⲁⲛⲧⲏ 'and they shall encounter' — Greek ἀπαντάω 'meet, encounter' as Coptic verb with ⲣ̄- prefix. The lacuna at end likely contained the object encountered.
Translated 'or yet again is.' ⲏ = Greek 'or'; ⲁⲉ = Lyc ⲇⲉ 'and/again'; ⲟⲉ uncertain — possibly ⲟⲛ 'again' or qualitative of ⲟⲩⲱ 'be, exist.' The whole introduces the alternative locus of disturbance.
Translated 'mixture of bitterness.' ⲧⲱⲍ = Lyc ⲧⲱϩ 'mix, mingle' substantivized; the bitterness mingles with the body's faculties through the food. Cosmological-physiological mingling.

Translated 'a lowly counsel.' ⲥⲁⲭⲛⲉ = 'counsel' (fourth of the five faculties); ⲭⲁⲃⲁⲁⲧ qualitative — in glossary as 'latter/abandoned'; here in moral register modifying 'counsel' I render 'lowly/abased' since the counsel is what brings the bitter members in upon the body.
Translated 'passes over.' Standard ⲟⲩⲱⲧⲃ̄ 'pass, transfer' (cf. accumulated ⲟⲩⲁⲧⲃⲉ 'be exalted'); here with directional ⲁ- 'to' = 'passes over to (becomes the cause of).'
Translated 'I have made known unto thee.' Per glossary entry ⲁⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲉ 'make known/reveal'; standard apostolic teaching-formula.

Translated 'being established.' 3sg.f circumstantial of ⲥⲁⲧϩ̄ 'be set, established.' The food is 'established' in the body in the favorable case (when the powers above are still), in contrast to its disturbance in the bitter case.

Translated 'the air of above.' ⲁⲏⲣ = Greek ἀήρ; ⲡⲕⲉ- here is article with emphasis 'and the air also' or simply 'the air.' Cosmological register: the upper air being still allows the icon to be at rest.
